description: Defines the HostResolverProc interface for DNS resolution, including chaining and fallback mechanisms, used in network address resolution within Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: HostResolverProc
classes.description: Interface for DNS host resolution procedures with chaining and fallback support.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a hostname to an address list, restricted by address family.

methods.name: Resolve (overload with network parameter)
methods.description: Resolves a hostname for a specific network handle.

methods.name: ResolveUsingPrevious
methods.description: Invokes the previous resolver in the chain.

methods.name: SetPreviousProc
methods.description: Sets the previous resolver in the chain.

methods.name: SetLastProc
methods.description: Appends a resolver to the end of the chain.

methods.name: GetLastProc
methods.description: Retrieves the last resolver in the chain.

methods.name: SetDefault
methods.description: Sets the default host resolver procedure.

methods.name: GetDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the current default host resolver procedure.
